events.title: Major Update: Mini-Con, the Wanderlings Series, and lot more
events.summary: What's NewMini-Con. The headline addition. You can now run themed events in your shop: schedule one on the event board, lay out figures on the tables, and watch the visitors roll in. Events can repeat daily until you call them off. The board unlocks at shop level 2, and the tutorial will walk you to it.The Wanderlings series. events.title: The Gacha Shop Simulator demo is out now
events.summary: The demo is live - you can play it right now, free, from this page. WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO You run a gacha shop. You stock blind boxes, set your prices, and watch customers work up the nerve to open one more. Behind the counter it's a management game about margins, shelf space and reading what people want.
